Data Engineering Intern (Summer Internship)

Help Build the Data Platforms That Power Business Decisions

Are you fascinated by data, cloud technology, and software development? Curious about how organizations manage and move millions of records every day?

Join Mapfre USA's Data Engineering team
for a 10-week summer internship (June 7 - August 13) in Webster, Massachusetts
and gain hands-on experience working alongside experienced engineers on real business challenges.

This is more than a traditional internship. You'll contribute to meaningful projects, learn modern data engineering practices, and gain exposure to the tools, technologies, and processes used to build and support enterprise-scale data platforms.

Whether you're interested in software engineering, data engineering, analytics, or cloud technologies, this internship offers an opportunity to develop highly marketable skills while working in a collaborative and innovative environment.

What You'll Do

As a Data Engineering Intern, you'll work directly with Data Engineers, Architects, Analysts, and business partners to support key initiatives across our data ecosystem. Opportunities may include:

Assisting with the design, development, testing, and support of modern data pipelines that move large datasets from source systems into enterprise data platforms.
Using SQL, Python, and programming fundamentals to transform, validate, and analyze data.
Building and enhancing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that help drive business decisions.
Supporting software development and coding projects related to data engineering and platform capabilities.
Helping investigate and resolve data quality issues, failed processes, and system performance challenges.
Learning how engineering teams monitor and maintain reliable, scalable, and observable data environments.
Working with data APIs, automation frameworks, and modern cloud-based technologies.
Participating in requirements gathering, technical design discussions, and solution development.
Creating technical documentation, process guides, and knowledge-sharing materials.
Collaborating with Product Managers, Engineers, Architects, and business stakeholders.
Participating in Agile team activities, including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and project reviews.
Gaining exposure to modern engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, data governance, cloud platforms, and AI-assisted development tools.

What You'll Learn

This internship is designed to bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world technology careers.

Throughout the summer, you'll gain practical experience in the complete data lifecycle:

Collect → Move → Transform → Validate → Monitor → Deliver Insights

You'll develop firsthand knowledge of how enterprise organizations build and manage modern data solutions while strengthening your technical, analytical, and professional skills.

By the end of the program, you'll have gained experience that can help prepare you for future internships, entry-level roles, and long-term careers in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Analytics, and related technology fields.

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking students who are curious, analytical, and excited to learn new technologies while contributing to meaningful work.

Minimum Qualifications

Currently enrolled in an accredited college or university degree program.
Undergraduate student (Rising Junior or Senior) or Graduate Student (Final Year).
Pursuing a degree in:
Computer Science
Data Science
Data Engineering
Software Engineering
Information Systems
Mathematics
Information Technology
Or a related field.

Familiarity with SQL, Python, and programming fundamentals.
Interest in data, databases, analytics, cloud computing, or software development.
Microsoft Office proficiency.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Mathematical aptitude and analytical thinking skills.
Problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
Knowledge of data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with Data APIs.
Comfortable collaborating with others, asking questions, and learning in a team environment.
Ability to provide your own transportation to our Webster, MA location.

Technologies & Skills You'll Use

You may gain experience with technologies and concepts such as:

Python
SQL
PySpark
Apache Airflow
Data APIs
Cloud Data Platforms
Git and Version Control
CI/CD Practices
Data Governance
Dashboarding and Data Visualization
Software Testing and Debugging
System Design Fundamentals
Agile Development Methodologies

Why Join Mapfre?

Work on real projects with experienced technology professionals.
Gain exposure to enterprise-scale data engineering practices.
Receive mentorship from Data Engineers, Architects, and business leaders.
Build technical skills that are highly valued in today's job market.
Collaborate in a professional Agile development environment.
Learn how modern organizations use data to support business decisions.
Develop practical experience you'll be able to showcase on future resumes and interviews.

No Prior Professional Experience Required

You don't need to know everything. That's why it's an internship.

We're looking for individuals who are curious about data, excited to learn, and eager to gain hands-on experience with modern technology. If you're interested in building your skills while working with a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

Some roles at Mapfre are eligible for commission and/or bonus earnings, in addition to salary, calculated based upon factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

added.description:
Gibson Dunn is a leading global law firm, advising clients on significant transactions and disputes. Our exceptional teams craft and deploy creative legal strategies that are meticulously tailored to every matter, however complex or high-stakes. The firm’s work is distinguished by a unique combination of precision and vision.

Based in Washington D.C, the Platform Engineering Specialist will assist with developing and maintaining the tools, services, and automation that support software delivery across the firm. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, this role contributes code, supports build and deployment pipelines, assists with cloud and infrastructure configuration, and helps resolve routine platform issues. The specialist follows established engineering practices while developing technical skills and taking on progressively more complex assignments. The platform supports conventional in-house software alongside AI workloads such as model inference, retrieval, and agent-based systems, all on a shared foundation. This role assists with the deployment, testing, and monitoring of these services using approved tools, procedures, and security controls.

Primary Applications And Platforms Include

CI/CD, Source Control & Test Automation: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins; Git, JFrog Artifactory; Playwright, pytest/JUnit
Infrastructure & Config as Code: Terraform, Ansible, Bicep/ARM, Helm, Kustomize; GitOps via Argo CD and Flux
Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes
AI Inference & Application Infrastructure: Frontier and open-weight models via Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and Amazon Bedrock; model gateways and routing, retrieval and hybrid search, document ingestion, tool/function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent orchestration
AI Evaluation & Quality: Eval harnesses and golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and human-in-the-loop review, regression suites, and red-teaming
Observability & Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, Elastic/ELK, OpenTelemetry, including GenAI tracing and token, latency, and cost telemetry
Platform Security & Policy-as-Code: HashiCorp Vault, OPA/Conftest, SAST/DAST
Developer Portal & Self-Service: Internal developer portal, CLIs/SDKs, and APIs

Experience with every tool is not required; training and guidance will be provided based on assigned responsibilities.

Responsibilities Include

Developer Experience & Self-Service Enablement

Assist with building and maintaining self-service tooling, CLIs, libraries, and templates, as version-controlled, tested code, that make it easy for teams to build, test, and ship software.
Contribute features and fixes to the internal developer platform and portal through pull requests and code review.
Provide initial support to developers using platform services, triaging and resolving requests and issues.
Support governed self-service access to AI platform capabilities, including model access, retrieval tooling, and evaluation workflows, so AI capabilities can move from prototype to production using standard platform patterns.

CI/CD, Release Management & Test Automation

Assist with implementing and maintaining pipelines-as-code (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps YAML) to established patterns, keeping builds, tests, and deployments reliable and fast.
Support release activities, following defined GitOps and change-management processes.
Write and maintain automated tests under guidance and help investigate build or test failures.
Run established AI evaluation and regression tests, document results, and flag failures or unexpected behavior for review.

Infrastructure as Code & Cloud Platforms

Update and maintain existing infrastructure code and configuration templates under the guidance of experienced engineers.Assist with deploying and operating workloads across cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and Kubernetes using GitOps (Argo CD/Flux).
Follow tagging, cost, and configuration standards when provisioning resources.
Help deploy and operate AI workload infrastructure, including model gateways, retrieval services, orchestration components, and supporting cloud or Kubernetes resources.

Observability, Monitoring & Site Reliability (SRE)

Instrument services and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting as code using standard tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
Participate in the on-call rotation, responding to incidents and helping restore service.
Contribute to blameless post-incident reviews and implement follow-up actions in code.
Instrument AI services for operational visibility, including tracing across prompts, tools, and agent steps, and monitoring latency, cost, token usage, and quality regressions.

Platform Security & Automation

Apply platform security controls and remediate vulnerabilities to defined standards, including policy-as-code checks (e.g., OPA/Conftest).
Assist with secrets, access, and configuration securely using approved tooling (e.g., Vault).
Follow security and confidentiality controls for AI workloads, including prompt-injection and data-exfiltration defenses, output filtering, and access controls across prompts, retrieval, and agent tool use.
Write and maintain scripts to automate routine operational tasks, with appropriate review and testing.

Software Engineering Standards & Collaboration

Follow engineering standards, version-control workflows, code-review, and testing practices.
Collaborate with platform and development teams and escalate complex issues appropriately.
Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and documentation as code alongside the tooling it describes.
Participate in team training, knowledge sharing, and feedback to develop platform engineering skills.

Qualifications

Foundational programming or scripting skills in at least one relevant language, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or Bash.
Basic familiarity with Git, version control, and software testing concepts.
Basic understanding of operating systems, networking, and technical troubleshooting.
Understanding of automated build, test, and deployment processes; exposure to GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools preferred.
Foundational knowledge of AWS or Azure; exposure through coursework, projects, or practical experience is welcome.
Exposure to infrastructure automation, Docker, Kubernetes, or GitOps concepts preferred.
Basic understanding of monitoring, logging, access controls, and secure handling of credentials.
Strong problem solving, communication, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
Familiarity with IT service management or Agile working practices preferred.
Relevant foundational cloud or technical certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure Associate, Certified Kubernetes Administrator) preferred.

Experience

0 to 5 years of relevant experience in platform engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, software development, or technical support. Internships, academic projects, practical training, and relevant personal projects will be considered.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Exposure to enterprise technology environments, including professional services, legal, or regulated organizations, preferred.

Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva is transforming autonomy with its groundbreaking sensing and perception technology that integrates all key LiDAR components onto a silicon photonics chip in a compact module. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions. 

Role Overview:

We're looking for a versatile engineer to serve as a critical bridge between our hardware, customer integration (FAE), and perception teams. As a shared resource, you will own the full lifecycle of our sensor data in the field. You will split your time between characterizing physical sensor performance, supporting customer deployments, and building the production-grade Python and C++ data pipelines required to ingest, validate, and label that data for our perception models.

Sensor Characterization & FAE Support:
Act as a technical liaison for customers. Assist with hardware integration and characterize 4D LiDAR performance (range, velocity, point cloud quality) in real-world environments to ensure optimal sensor deployment.

Data Infrastructure:
Develop Python and C++ infrastructure to ingest, validate, and organize data from collection vehicles and customer fleets: handling file verification, metadata extraction, and database writes.

Calibration & Field Debugging:
Run camera, LiDAR, and GPS calibration workflows on internal data collection vehicles and customer platforms. Debug hardware/software integration issues including sensor connectivity, logging failures, and network dropouts.

Pipelines & Labeling:
Build and maintain ETL pipelines that move high-volume sensor data to internal storage. Collaborate with external annotation vendors to package data for delivery, validate returned labels, and flag quality issues for the perception team.

Operations Execution:
Collaborate with operations and customer engineering teams to plan, support, and execute comprehensive data collection runs.

Willingness to travel up to 20%

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Optics, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

3+ years of industry experience blending software development (production Python and C++) with hardware/systems engineering (2+ years with a Master's).

Hands-on experience with LiDAR, radar, or camera systems, including hardware troubleshooting, calibration, and point cloud analysis.

Strong fundamentals in software engineering (data structures, system design) and experience designing or operating data pipelines at scale.

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues between external customers, hardware engineers, and perception software teams.

Familiarity with robotics or autonomous systems data such as ROS, sensor logs, binary formats, or perception datasets is a strong plus.

Ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment with ambiguous requirements.

added.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Our Summer Internship program is a wonderful opportunity for Fall and Spring graduates to immerse themselves in an innovative and mission driven culture. Our paid internship program will provide you with hands on mentorship, an opportunity to add real contribution to our company via your internship project, and a possible job offer at the end. You will have the chance to make lifelong friendships, expand your network, and learn all about what it's like to work in a high-growth, fast scaling tech unicorn. You'll take part in company sponsored events and enjoy exploring a new city. Read on below to learn more about this unique internship!

About The Role

Shield AI's Software Development Engineer Intern program spans engineers who design, build, and test the code that powers our autonomous systems — from user-facing applications and embedded flight software to machine learning models and the underlying systems platforms that tie it all together. Over 10–12 weeks, interns work alongside full-time engineers to analyze requirements, write and debug production-quality code, and ship a real feature or capability using our standard Agile development practices.
Example Intern Projects
Applications: Build a new feature or internal tool (web, mobile, or desktop) that streamlines a mission-planning or fleet-management workflow.
Firmware/Embedded: Develop and debug embedded C/C++ code for a flight controller or sensor module, including bring-up and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
Machine Learning: Train, evaluate, and integrate a perception or decision-making model (e.g., object detection, sensor fusion) into an autonomy pipeline.
Systems Development: Extend a platform tool, API, or data pipeline that supports autonomy software, simulation, or cloud infrastructure.

Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., C, C++, Python, Java, or JavaScript)
Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles
Experience writing, testing, and debugging code, whether through coursework, personal projects, or prior internships
Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous requirements into working code
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to mobile or web application frameworks and full-stack development
Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, real-time operating systems, or assembly-level debugging
Coursework or projects involving machine learning, statistics, probability theory, or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Experience with cloud platforms, databases, networking, or distributed systems
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies
Prior internship, research, or club/competition experience in robotics, autonomy, or aerospace applications
Interest in or exposure to the defense, aerospace, or autonomous systems industry

As a Senior Software Engineer, 5G Networking, you will build and harden the software inside our tactical secure 5G base station: the 5G core and RAN software, the Linux networking underneath it, and the packaging and security that let it deploy into austere and contested environments. You will work with open-source 5G stacks (such as OpenAirInterface, Open5GS, and srsRAN), extend and integrate them, and make them reliable enough to field.

5G Core and RAN Software

Develop, integrate, and maintain 5G core network functions and RAN software built on open-source stacks, including configuration, feature additions, and upstream patch management.
Integrate the RAN software with the radio hardware, timing, and core network, and troubleshoot registration, session, mobility, and throughput issues across the stack.
Implement features for tactical use: standalone core operation, disconnected and intermittent backhaul, and multi-node or mesh configurations.

Linux Networking and Deployment

Build and tune the Linux networking layer: routing, VLANs, tunneling, QoS, and user plane performance.
Package and deploy the software with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or lightweight equivalents) for repeatable builds and field updates.
Build automated build, test, and release pipelines, including lab and over-the-air test automation.

Experience with containers and automated build and deployment.

Assured Space Access Technologies, Inc. is a defense and engineering firm delivering phased array, radar, RF payload, and secure communications solutions to government and prime contractor customers. We are headquartered in Irvine, California. This role joins the Radar Computer team within Ground Based Radar, which owns the processing hardware and real-time software platform that carry the radar from digitized data to detections, tracks, and control.

Team:
Engineering, Ground Based Radar (GBR), Radar Computer Team

Irvine, CA (on-site)

$155,000 – $210,000 per year

Clearance:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. An active clearance is preferred.

Position Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Radar Computer team, you will build the real-time software platform the radar runs on: the framework, data movement, scheduling, timing, and operating system configuration that carry digitized array data through signal processing and tracking, and carry commands back out to the array. Signal processing, embedded array control, and operator applications are written by the GBR Software Engineering team. Your job is to give that code a fast, deterministic, well-instrumented platform to run on.

You will work with the compute hardware engineer, the radar computer supplier, systems engineers who set latency and throughput budgets, and the application software engineers who build on your platform. This is a senior individual contributor seat for an engineer who has built real-time, high-throughput software infrastructure for radar, electronic warfare, sensors, or similar systems.

Key Responsibilities

Real-Time Platform

Design and build the real-time processing framework: pipeline and data flow architecture, zero-copy data movement between network, CPU, GPU, and storage, and the APIs application teams build on.
Implement the radar scheduler and timing services that coordinate dwells, beam commands, and processing with the radar timeline.
Configure and tune Linux for deterministic performance: real-time kernel settings, CPU isolation, NUMA placement, interrupt affinity, and high-performance networking (DPDK, RDMA, or similar).

Integration and Supplier Software

Integrate and own the software delivered with the supplier-provided radar computer, and define the boundary between supplier software and in-house software.
Connect the platform to digital receiver/exciter data streams and array control interfaces, and support hardware-in-the-loop and field testing.
Build high-rate data recording and playback for test, debug, and algorithm development.

Engineering Infrastructure

Own build systems, continuous integration, automated testing, and deployment for radar compute software, consistent with defense software practices.
Build instrumentation, logging, and performance monitoring that show throughput, latency, and health in real time.
Write and maintain interface control documents and software design documentation.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of professional software development, including at least 4 years building real-time or high-throughput systems software in modern C++ on Linux.
Experience designing data pipelines and high-rate data movement between processes and nodes (shared memory, DPDK, RDMA, or similar).
Experience with real-time Linux tuning, multithreading, and deterministic scheduling.
Experience integrating GPU (CUDA) processing into a pipeline at the framework level.
Experience with continuous integration, automated testing, and build tooling (CMake, Git, containers).
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.
Ability to work on site in Irvine, CA.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with radar, electronic warfare, SIGINT, or sonar real-time processing systems.
Experience integrating with FPGA-based front ends or digital receivers.
Familiarity with middleware such as DDS or ZeroMQ and with time synchronization (PTP).
Experience building high-rate data recording and playback systems.
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
Active Secret or higher security clearance.

Relocation assistance considered case by case.
Hands-on ownership of real scope in a growing defense technology company.
